At the same time, it says it will thoroughly rationalize production and logistics and carry out planned capital investment at its Koshigaya and Hyogo plants. As issues to address, it gives top priority to securing stable supplies of raw materials by diversifying procurement routes, and to flexibly revising selling prices in response to market price fluctuations.
